selection: Earliest timestamp, row-index tie-break, after source-defined aviary1/cycle1 exclusion; subject and first context fixed without response selection.
source_time_zone: not specified in deposited table; native values retained
reference: Independent positional-reader sums and exact source-row identity checks passed.

semantics.observation: Probe playback followed by left/right perch choice in trained categorical-similarity task.
semantics.stimuli: Deposited representative left/right training identities and actual probe sound_id, not a controlled scalar edit.
semantics.feedback: Paper states either probe side rewarded. No delivered reward field in this table; intended protocol is not hardware verification.
semantics.NA: Literal NA retained separately; no claim that it is a biological omission rather than unrecorded response.
semantics.correction: No subject-produced song, revision direction, target acceptability or song-learning endpoint in these rows.
semantics.training_accuracy: acc_cycle is supplied all-cycle summary, not reconstructed from this probe-only export.

exposure.all_rows: Full CSV bytes acquired/hashed/decoded; all17 fields tokenized in both readers, all subject/context/time/probe status metadata scanned.
exposure.numeric_interpretation: Only selected subject/context binary choice counts and repeated-probe choices; first five excluded-cycle rows already inspected during schema check.
exposure.not_holdout: No acquired or tokenized row is pristine unacquired evaluation; no new scientific comparison yet.

parser_correction: Initial strict Left/Right assertion failed on literal NA. Follow-up also exposed mixed ISO and day/month timestamps; lexicographic earliest was wrong. Both failed passes preserved in failure record and diagnostic. No endpoint/model selection change.
